items.title: Variables, let/const, and the basic types
items.teaches: Store a value in a name, choose between let and const, and say what type a value is.

items.title: Strings and template literals
items.teaches: Build and inspect text with template literals and the common string methods.

items.title: Numbers, math, and NaN
items.teaches: Do arithmetic, round on purpose, and recognise where NaN comes from.

items.title: Booleans, comparison, === vs ==, truthy and falsy
items.teaches: Compare values safely and predict which values count as true.

items.title: if / else and the ternary
items.teaches: Run different code for different inputs, and pick a value with a ternary.

items.title: Loops: for, while, for...of
items.teaches: Repeat work a fixed number of times, until a condition changes, or once per item.

items.title: Functions: parameters, defaults, return
items.teaches: Package logic into a named function that takes inputs and returns a value.

items.title: Arrow functions and scope
items.teaches: Write arrow functions and predict which variables are visible where.

items.title: Arrays: indexing, push/pop, slice vs splice
items.teaches: Build lists, read them by position, and tell copying apart from mutating.

items.title: Array methods: map, filter, find, some, every
items.teaches: Transform and search arrays without writing the loop yourself.

items.title: reduce, on its own
items.teaches: Collapse an array into one value, and trace the accumulator step by step.

items.title: Objects: properties, nesting, optional chaining
items.teaches: Group related values under names and read nested data without crashing.

items.title: Destructuring, spread and rest
items.teaches: Unpack arrays and objects, copy them with changes, and collect extra arguments.

items.title: Looping over objects: Object.keys / values / entries
items.teaches: Walk through an object's properties when you do not know the key names in advance.

items.title: Map and Set, and when they beat a plain object
items.teaches: Count, deduplicate, and look things up with the two collections built for the job.

items.title: Sorting and comparator functions
items.teaches: Sort numbers and objects correctly, and know why the default sort surprises you.

items.title: Functions that take functions
items.teaches: Pass a function as an argument and write a function that calls the one it is given.

items.title: Closures
items.teaches: Return a function that remembers the variables it was created next to.

items.title: Errors: throw, try / catch, and stack traces
items.teaches: Raise your own errors, catch the ones you expect, and read where one came from.

items.title: JSON: parse, stringify, and why it exists
items.teaches: Turn data into text and back, and handle text that is not valid JSON.

items.title: Classes, methods, and this
items.teaches: Define a class with a constructor and methods, and know what this refers to.

items.title: Modules: import and export
items.teaches: Split code across files and pull pieces back together with import and export.

items.title: Promises
items.teaches: Work with a value that is not ready yet, using then and catch.

items.title: async / await, and calling a real API with fetch
items.teaches: Write asynchronous code that reads top to bottom, and request data over the network.
